body:
Closes #3 Ticket: [ALBUM-3](https://github.com/dbeallor/album-ranker/issues/3). Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-album-3-stack-scaffold.md`. Plan: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-20-album-3-stack-scaffold.md`. ## What this does Picks the stack (TypeScript, Next.js App Router, npm, Vitest, ESLint) and commits a runnable empty scaffold: one blank home page, a config module that reads `DATABASE_PATH` from the environment, two test files, and the stack doc. `docs/agents/project.md` now has real Test, Lint and Typecheck commands and an Areas list. ## Proof - **Fresh clone runs the app and the tests**: README "Run the app" steps; `npm run dev` served `/` with `

Album ranker

` (curl on a spare port, stopped afterwards). A fresh clone of this branch passed `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`. ``` $ npm test Test Files 2 passed (2) Tests 5 passed (5) $ npm run lint (no errors) $ npm run typecheck (no errors) $ npm run build Route (app) ┌ ○ / └ ○ /_not-found ``` - **`project.md` has real Test, Lint and Typecheck values**: `docs/agents/project.md` § Commands rows are `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`; § Areas and labels lists `app/`, `components/`, `lib/`, `scripts/`, `docs/`. - **Stack choice written down with the reason**: `docs/stack.md`. - **No secret, `.env` or database file committed**: `git ls-files | grep -E '\.env$|^data/|\.db$'` prints nothing; `.gitignore` covers `.env*` (except `.env.example`), `data/`, `*.db`, `*.sqlite*`. Not proven: - Running on a machine that is not this one: only a fresh clone on the same machine was tried (no CI yet, out of scope). - The home page in a browser: checked with curl only, not a screenshot. Context size: pass skipped (not collective-wisdom)

comments.body:
## Code review (pass 1) Reviewed `git diff origin/main...HEAD` at `1a0aaf2` and reproduced the proof in a fresh clone: `npm ci`, `npm test` (2 files, 5 tests), `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` all pass; `next dev` serves `/` with `

Album ranker

`; `git status` stays clean afterwards. Nothing is out of scope. The as-built deviations (TypeScript 6.0.x, `vitest.config.mts`, committed `AGENTS.md`, four config cases) are explained. Acceptance: (1) fresh clone runs app and tests: proven and reproduced; (2) `project.md` Commands has real values (`docs/agents/project.md:45-47`); (3) stack and reason in `docs/stack.md`. No Proof gaps. Findings (nits only, no Must fix or Should fix): - `app/page.test.tsx:6`: Testing Library auto-cleanup needs a global `afterEach`, and `globals` is off in `vitest.config.mts`. Harmless with one test; the first ticket adding a second component test in a file should add `globals: true` or a `cleanup()` setup file. - `lib/config.test.ts:17-21`: the `env === undefined` branch duplicates the else branch, since `vi.stubEnv` handles `undefined`. - `lib/config.test.ts:9-13`: `expected: string | Error` is roundabout; optional. - `docs/agents/project.md:79`: `server-only` isn't installed yet; whichever ticket adds the first server-only module (#4 or #5) adds it. No change here. Verdict: PASS

## Security review (pass 1)

PR #16 at `1a0aaf2`, scope `git diff origin/main...HEAD`. A scaffold with no attack surface yet: one static page, no route handlers, server actions, auth, database access or outbound requests. No blocking findings.

- **Secrets and ignore rules:** no secrets tracked; `.env.example` holds only the non-secret default. `git check-ignore` confirms `.env*` (except `.env.example`), `data/`, `*.db`, `*.sqlite*` and `.next/` are ignored.
- **A03 Supply chain:** lockfile v3, 492 entries, every `resolved` URL on registry.npmjs.org with an integrity hash. Only `fsevents` has an install script (the known optional macOS watcher). `npm audit`: 0 vulnerabilities. `npm audit signatures` verified 409 packages. Unfamiliar transitive names resolve from the registry and belong to known trees; no typosquats.
- **A02 Misconfiguration:** `next.config.ts` is defaults, `strict: true`, no `NEXT_PUBLIC_*`; `DATABASE_PATH` is read only in `lib/config.ts`.
- **A05 / ASVS V5:** `getConfig()` rejects empty and whitespace-only values; the operator sets it and no user reaches it.

| Severity | Location | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| Info | `lib/config.ts` | Does not import `server-only` yet. Nothing imports it today; add the import when #4 first uses it. |
| Info | `lib/config.ts` | `DATABASE_PATH` is accepted as-is. If a later ticket joins it with user input (e.g. #10), resolve and confine paths under a base directory. |

Verdict: PASS
